items.question: How do I choose the right machines for my factory?
items.answer: Tell us your target capacity (kg per hour or tonnes per day), your raw cashew origin and size, and your available space and power. Our engineers will recommend a line layout and machine list.

items.question: Can your machines handle raw cashew from different countries?
items.answer: Yes. Blades, screens, and settings are adjustable for different nut sizes. We tune each machine for the raw material you will process.

items.question: Do you offer complete processing lines?
items.answer: Yes. We supply every stage from raw nut grading, steaming, and shelling to drying, humidifying, peeling, kernel grading, and packing, and we can also supply single machines to upgrade an existing line.

items.question: How do I get a price?
items.answer: Use the Request a quote button on any machine page or contact us by phone, WhatsApp, Zalo, or email. We will reply with a quotation based on your requirements.

items.question: What is the typical lead time?
items.answer: Standard machines usually ship within 20 to 30 days after order confirmation. Complete lines take longer depending on configuration.

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: Yes. We export by sea freight and prepare all standard export documents. We can quote FOB or CIF to your nearest port.

items.question: Do you install the machines?
items.answer: Yes. Our engineers install and commission the machines on site and train your operators and maintenance staff.

items.question: What warranty do you provide?
items.answer: Machines come with a 12-month warranty on manufacturing defects. Wear parts such as blades and belts are excluded but are available from stock.

items.question: How do I get spare parts and support?
items.answer: Contact our after-sales team by phone, WhatsApp, or Zalo. Common spare parts are kept in stock and shipped quickly.
